tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search works by title, artist, series, NASA ID, or keywords. Returns compact records sorted by PPI.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Return one work by id, title, accession number, or NASA ID.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List collection rows and how many works each contains.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Store policies as JSON: shipping (free, US only, 14–21 days), returns (30-day money back by mail; buyer pays return shipping), payment (Stripe Checkout), sales tax, and contact.

tools.name: get_print_options
tools.description: Sizes, frames, and prices the site offers for one work. Sizes respect the scan's resolution (100 PPI minimum). Prices include the frame and shipping; tax is added at checkout.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price a framed print: unit price, subtotal, shipping, and total before tax, with a summary of the store policies. Ships to the US only; tax is calculated by Stripe at checkout.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for this order and return checkout_url, order_ref, and a summary of the store policies. Give the link to the buyer; they enter the address and pay on Stripe. This never charges a card. Rate-limited.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Checkout, payment, and shipping status for an order_ref from create_checkout. Returns no personal data.
